title: SciPy, official statistical reference, hypergeom
content_checked: Formula matches sampling without replacement with population M, marked n, draws N.

title: SciPy, official statistical reference, binomtest
locator: Parameters alternative; null Bernoulli success probability
content_checked: Supports exact binomial testing; applying it to non-tied paired signs additionally requires independent fair signs under the null.

title: Gneiting and Raftery (2007), Strictly Proper Scoring Rules, Prediction, and Estimation
content_checked: Proper scoring rules reward honest probabilities; categorical quadratic/Brier score is a probabilistic forecast metric, not a support-weight metric.

title: Shannon (1948), A Mathematical Theory of Communication
content_checked: Entropy and conditional uncertainty are properties of probability laws; information quantities alone do not identify causal direction.

title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy, Decision Theory
content_checked: Expected-utility representation needs preference axioms; normative coherence is different from empirical predictive accuracy.

title: Pearl (2009), Causal inference in statistics: An overview
content_checked: Interventions replace structural mechanisms. Back-door adjustment requires an appropriate causal graph and sufficient adjustment set.

title: Carroll (1997), Lecture Notes on General Relativity
locator: PDF p.14 light cones; p.133 closed timelike curves and domain of dependence
content_checked: Light-cone causal structure restricts local propagation. Mathematical spacetimes with CTCs compromise global initial-value formulations; these notes do not demonstrate a built time machine.

title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy, Thermodynamic Asymmetry in Time
content_checked: Macroscopic asymmetry and low-entropy boundary conditions are distinct from the symmetry properties of microscopic evolution. Explanatory proposals are discussed, not experimentally established retrocausal signalling.

title: Leifer and Pusey (2017), Is a time symmetric interpretation of quantum theory possible without retrocausality?
locator: PDF p.1 abstract; p.9 Theorem VIII.1
content_checked: Conditional ontological theorem involves operational time reversal, Time Symmetry, No Retrocausality and lambda-mediation; violation does not uniquely establish physical backward signalling.

title: Kay, Radzikowski and Wald (1997), Quantum Field Theory on Spacetimes with a Compactly Generated Cauchy Horizon
content_checked: Specific scalar-field/Hadamard/F-locality assumptions yield breakdown at base points of a compactly generated horizon. This is not a universal proof that every CTC is impossible.

title: Hensen et al. (2015), Experimental loophole-free violation of a Bell inequality using entangled electron spins separated by 1.3 km
locator: PDF p.1 abstract; experimental and statistical sections
content_checked: Reports a 245-trial Bell test and a rejection of specified local-realist models. This is not an experiment establishing usable messages from the future.

title: Stanford CS229, main lecture notes, Learning theory
locator: PDF p.129 Hoeffding lemma statement (iid Bernoulli form)
content_checked: Verified special-case concentration inequality. The general bounded-variable interval used here is derived separately in STATISTICS.md; do not attribute its general statement to this page.

title: NIST (2010), NIST Pair of Aluminum Atomic Clocks Reveal Einstein’s Relativity at a Personal Scale
locator: Article reporting the Science measurement, paragraph on 33 centimetres
content_checked: Official institutional account reports a gravitational rate difference at a 33-cm height difference. It verifies the account, not an independent reanalysis of raw clock data.

title: RFC 3161 (2001), Internet X.509 Public Key Infrastructure Time-Stamp Protocol
content_checked: A trusted third party timestamps a datum/hash under explicit trust and verification requirements; a local JSON timestamp is not equivalent.
